messages:
jordan: Heads-up — ran into inconsistent error shapes between the Python and JS SDKs in the onboarding sample app.
anya: ugh, which endpoint / error code?
jordan: On token refresh flow. Python returns a typed RefreshTokenError with .retryable = true and a nice message. JS just gives 401 + 'Unauthorized' string.
mo: that sounds bad. Do you have a repro?
jordan: yep — sample-app/auth-refresh demo. Steps: (1) create short-lived test key, (2) call /v1/generate until token expires, (3) attempt automatic refresh. JS path throws a plain error from fetch: `Error: 401` and we lose the retry hint.
lee: can you paste the JS stack / snippet?
jordan: ```js
// snippet from sdk client in sample-app
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (e) {
  // e.message == '401' so we can't tell if it's transient or auth-refresh needed
}
```
anya: important for onboarding — folks will copy sample app behavior. If JS doesn't surface typed errors we break retry semantics.
mo: do we have an SDK parity issue filed?
jordan: not yet. Wanted to crowdsource the mapping first: what should the canonical shape be across SDKs? I vote: { name: 'RefreshTokenError', code: 401, retryable: true, hint: 'attempt token refresh then retry' }
lee: +1. Also include original_http_status and raw_body for troubleshooting.
anya: agree but keep top-level fields small and stable. Add a top-level `kind` or `type` string so typed checks are easy in JS.
mo: ops question — is 401 always refreshable? What about 401 from malformed key vs expired token?
jordan: good point. We could use subcodes: 401.1 = invalid, 401.2 = expired. Sample app should treat 401.2 as retryable.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: we're rolling out token-introspection changes to auth-service in next patch window (eta 48h).
anya: timeline is fine but we should avoid coupling SDK parity to service rollout. Suggest: SDKs map services errors to canonical typed errors client-side.
mo: actionables: 1) file SDK parity issue with concrete schema, 2) patch sample-app to rely on typed errors not raw strings, 3) add a unit test in CI that asserts SDK error shape for refresh cases.
jordan: created minimal repro in GH gist and will open the issue with proposed schema.
lee: can we add a short snippet for docs — "recommended retry semantics" — to reduce onboarding friction?
jordan: yes, will add a short cookbooks section: what to do on RefreshTokenError, when to backoff, how to log.
anya: for the issue, please include a tiny compatibility plan: how to roll out without breaking existing consumers (feature-flag SDK change + telemetry for uncaught strings).
mo: I'll take JS SDK patch and tests. tagging @devex for coordination.
devex-bot: noted. Created issue DEVEX-4872: "SDK parity: canonical error shape for token refresh & onboarding sample". Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4872
jordan: thanks — moving sample-app PR into draft. I'll update thread when PR is ready.
lee: small UX nit: sample-app should log human-friendly messages in onboarding flow, not raw status codes. That reduces support tickets.
anya: agreed. Also add a tiny e2e that simulates expired key so new devs see the intended refresh flow.
mo: will send PR by EOD with tests.
jordan: solid — appreciate the quick sync. :thumbsup:
